name: zsnd_backend_shutdown
description: zSndBackend::Shutdown gates on initialized/preinitialized state, shuts down CD/stream/sample registries, releases backend handles for DirectSound or A3D, clears initialization state, and returns the shutdown result.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The A3D and DirectSound release paths are verified with fake COM-style release providers rather than live audio backends.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a1f40 validates returning 0 unless both g_zSnd_Initialized and g_zSnd_PreInitialized are set, then calling zSndCd::Shutdown, zSndStreamMgr::Shutdown, and zSndSampleSetRegistry::DestroyAll, releasing backend listener/device handles for DirectSound, releasing A3D geom/listener/device handles and calling CoUninitialize for A3D, clearing g_zSnd_Initialized, and returning 1.
The dependency frontier for 0x4a1f40 has source-ready direct callees after accepting the CD, stream-manager, and sample-set registry shutdown targets.
The native backend shutdown smoke verifies the not-initialized gate plus DirectSound and A3D release paths; dependency smokes cover the composed teardown callees.
